listings.description: RISVELIUM The scent of awakening, an inhale that fractures the ordinary and exalts the extraordinary. It draws from the unseen forces that bind the earthly and the ethereal, a bridge between the tangible and the transcendent. The soul's journey is both the question and the answer. Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz . . .

LUXURY RAG This is a luxury rag. My fascination for materials has led me to put fabric creation and development at the heart of this garment. The pattern has been woven by a renowned Italian weaving house into a fine jacquard made of natural fibres only. The craftsmanship of the fabric is exposed to reflect the Orto Parisi charm and artistry. The free-running and irregular yarns are inherent to this particular process of weaving, as well as the effects of time and wear on the loose yarns. Both are intricate parts of the life and soul of the garment. A pigment dye with coffee residue has been used to give the fabric an aged look. The variations in colour intensity that give the product an imperfect appearance are a precise characteristic of this artisanal process. As the fabric is two-sided, the robe can be worn inside-out with its construction laid bare. It can be washed and ironed, but the result will be noticeable on the fabric; the edges will lighten, and the threads will swell. If you wish to preserve the original look of the garment, you should opt for dry cleaning only. . .

CUOIUM A visceral connection. Cuoium is an embodiment of love and respect towards natural materials – a manifestation of the legacy of leather. Contemporary paganism. Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . . .

MEGAMARE Sights. It is an indomitable depth, the unknown, a call towards all and nothing – here, there, everywhere. The wholeness of the sea doesn’t need an explanation. Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . . .

TERRONI There is something fulfilling about putting your hands in the soil – the sense of belonging to earth. Roots play a strong part in the growth and development of a character. They are burned into your being. Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . .

SEMINALIS Seminalis is our first stimulus in a fragrance bottle. An aromatic aldehyde which helps sperm to locate the ovum, biological proof of olfactive attraction. Life initiated by smell. Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . .

VIRIDE A robust green character. A character of Yemeni man, who wears his traditional floral crown. Viride represents a garden that has been planted, fertilized, and cultivated. From the deepest and strongest roots of herbal plants, the only way is up now. Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . .

BOCCANERA A fragrance that is covered with darkness, that steals the kiss and leaves a spicy aftertaste on the lips. Boccanera strikes a confusing balance between scent and flavor, between love and fear . Parfum 50ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . .

STERCUS Stercus never lies. A part of the essential body functioning and a natural way to fertilize the soil. It is the secret sweetness that attracts, and the animalic side that offends. A sign of an infinite life circle. The smell of an end and the beginning. Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . .

TOOL BAG This is a tool bag meant for your hammer, screwdriver, and any other utensils you may wish to carry along with you — including your phone, wallet, self-care products, and perfumes. My fascination for materials has led me to put leather at the heart of this piece. . The leather comes from a renowned Italian tannery, where the traditional process of pit tanning is still practiced — a type of treatment that best preserves the typical characteristics of artisanal cowhide such as: smell, suppleness, and elasticity.. Wear and time will affect the leather, and the bag will darken giving each piece its own unique character. It is an intricate part of the life and charm of the bag. .

. BERGAMASK Bergamask is a perfume extract that reveals itself very slowly, not within hours, it stays and plays. A sting that cuts through everything, you revel in the odor of a fresh kill. The cycle of life shaped by attraction and repulsion. . . Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl.oz SOLD OUT. .

BRUTUS To those who seize what’s precious to them the present is eternal. Brutus steals the time by remaining stable and unchangeable. A man who lacked eloquence in his actions, a man who was terrifying yet full of kindness. Parfum 50ml/1.7 fl.oz . . . . . . .
